properties.description: Detects attempts to remove traces of Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) activity by clearing specific event logs, deleting registry keys, or removing cache files. This rule identifies command-line actions using 'wevtutil' to clear RDP operational logs, 'reg delete' for RDP client registry keys, and 'del' or 'remove-item' for RDP bitmap cache files. It also directly monitors registry events for RDP client key deletions and file events for RDP cache file deletions.
